purpose: Assess whether the independently observable semantic future representation and its controlled reassignment provide an identifiable operational contrast for the primary mechanism, without treating the study as a confirmatory replication-counted test.
primary_question: Can the action-identity × future-representation-assignment contrast be operationally identified while preserving the predecision boundary between selected action and realized successor?

not_target: determination of a statistically sufficient replication count

required_pre_execution_outputs: independent reconstruction of the mapping and successor generation
verification that the null removes action-to-future information while preserving relevant surface structure
verification that successor and T_acc remain hidden before the decision
verification that no normative, reward, utility, performance, quality, or success signal enters the decision input
decision_boundary: No scientific execution may begin until the methodological acceptance criteria are explicitly specified and passed.
